sources.title: LocateAnything-3B: Image-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview LocateAnything-3B is a vision-language model for visual grounding and object localization built by nvidia. The model predicts bounding box coordinates and points from natural language queries, supporting tasks like referring expression grounding, multi-object detection, GUI element grounding, and text localization across complex scenes. sources.title: GitHub - gammahazard/locate-anything: Sleek, mobile-friendly web UI for ...
sources.snippet: A sleek, mobile-friendly web UI for NVIDIA LocateAnything-3B — point it at an image, type what you want to find in plain language, and get bounding boxes back. Object detection, phrase grounding, OCR/text localization, document layout, GUI element grounding, and pointing — all from one prompt box. Run it on your own NVIDIA GPU with a single docker compose up.
